notes: Fixed big FPS spikes: a ▬▬▬ chat line held for a loot roll was put back into chat over and over, and every mod re-read it each time
Powder mining chests count again: putting that line back could end a chest's loot before its rewards came in
Held chat lines now go straight back into chat, so other mods' trackers don't count those drops twice
Works with chat-compacting mods: "REWARDS (5)" isn't counted as an item
Fixed heavy FPS lag with tracker cards on the HUD: they're now worked out a few times a second instead of every frame
The craft plan HUD no longer rebuilds every item icon from your storage every 2 seconds, just the counts
Saving your storage and item icons happens in the background, so the game no longer freezes while those big files are written
The garden visitor helper no longer looks through all your storage every frame
Drops in chat with a repeat counter from a chat-compacting mod, like "x64 (2)", are counted properly
Anything that gets a roll waits in chat until its roll lands: rare drops, sea creature, slayer, Diana and Scatha drops, catches, gifts, and Nucleus, corpse and treasure loot
The ▬▬▬ line above a rolled loot message waits too
Messages are held back only after other mods have seen them, so SkyHanni and Skyblocker trackers still count them
Corpse rolls leave out HOTM Exp as well as powder
Gemstone names no longer keep the symbol in front of them
Loot reveal: much more to spin for, each with its own switch in /jerry settings → Reveals
Crystal Nucleus: a roll for every item in the bundle, and the loot message waits in chat until the rolls are done
Croesus: each chest you claim gets a spin, runs you finished earlier too
Kismet: rerolling a dungeon chest spins the old best item and the new one
Mineshaft corpses: a roll for every item from Lapis, Tungsten, Umber and Vanguard corpses (powder left out)
Scatha mining: worm and Scatha drops in the Crystal Hollows get a roll
Sea creature, slayer, Diana and other rare drops get a roll, and each drop can be switched off in Reveal drops…
Great and Outstanding catches, gifts, and Crystal Hollows treasure chests (off at first) can spin too
Your drops are always sent to Jerry while a tracker runs; the Trackers tab now picks which trackers show on your HUD
Tracker HUD: every player card (and every tracker's block) is its own HUD part, so each moves and resizes on its own in /jerry hud
Trackers you put on the HUD stay there when they stop, marked stopped, instead of vanishing
Players view: a tracker with nobody on it yet still shows a card
Cards and lists show every drop, not just the top 3
Drops menu: turn each drop on or off on the HUD, for every tracker (Drops… in /jerry gui, or /jerry hud drops)
Right-click a drop in the Drops menu to pin it to the top of the cards
Cards show how long the tracker has been running
Gemstones always count as rough: flawed, fine, flawless and perfect are worked out in rough and added in (80 rough = 1 flawed, 80 flawed = 1 fine, 80 fine = 1 flawless, 5 flawless = 1 perfect)
Hide when idle: a card with no new drops for 3 minutes hides until something new drops (change it in the Drops menu)
/jerry settings has every setting in one place, in tabs: General, Trackers, HUD, Reveals and Helpers (the Extras page is gone, its settings moved there)
Menus share one look and tidier code underneath
HUD layouts: Default, Dungeons, Mining, Farming and Fishing can each have their own HUD layout, picked at the top of /jerry hud
The mod switches layout by where you are (a fishing rod in your hand counts as fishing). Turn Auto-switch off in /jerry hud
Tracker counts on your HUD: in /jerry gui, pick a tracker and press Show on HUD. Move it with /jerry hud
Show your counts, everyone's added together, or each player's (the Mine / Everyone / Players button in /jerry gui)
Players view: a card per player with their skin's face, the tracker and what they've collected
Pick players: a face for everyone who linked the mod, click to add or remove their card, or type any name (/jerry hud players, /jerry hud add <name>)
What's changed: the update box lists every change since your version, and after updating a chat message links to them
/jerry changelog shows every version's changes, and the mod page has a full changelog
Quick call uses the exact name /call takes for each contact (Maddox the Slayer is /call maddox, Feast Baker Scott is /call Scott, Spider Tamer is /call SpiderTamer, Crag is /call kuudra...)
Hover a contact to see the exact /call it will run
Quick call menu: /ace call (or set a Quick call key in Controls) shows your Abiphone contacts as heads. Click to call, right-click or F to star
New Quick call menu: /ace call (or set a Quick call key in Controls) shows your Abiphone contacts as heads, like the storage viewer
Click a contact to call them (Hypixel's /call). Search by name or where they are, sort A-Z or by recent
Right-click or F stars a contact so it pins to the top; middle-click removes one
Open your Abiphone once (each page) and the mod remembers your contacts
HUD editor: Ctrl+Z undoes your last change (move, resize, put back, Reset all) and Ctrl+Y redoes it
Drag a corner of any HUD part to resize it, like a picture in Word: the opposite corner stays put and it keeps its shape
Scrolling over a part still resizes it in 10% steps
/jerry hud shows other mods' HUD parts too (Skyblocker, SkyHanni, Odin and more) plus Minecraft's own; right-click one for that mod's settings
/jerry hud now shows other mods' HUD parts too (Skyblocker, SkyHanni, Odin and more), plus Minecraft's own: scoreboard, boss bar, potion effects, hotbar
Drag any of them to move it and scroll to resize. Purple boxes are Ace, blue boxes are other mods
Right-click another mod's part to open that mod's settings; shift+right-click puts any part back
A list down the side opens each HUD mod's settings, so their own HUD editors are all one click away
Reset all puts every part back, Ace's and other mods'
Keep several plans: craft plans and shard plans are all saved, and the ◀ ▶ buttons in /jerry plan switch between them
Save a copy of your website plan, or delete a saved one, from /jerry plan
New HUD editor (/jerry hud, or Edit HUD in /jerry settings): drag every Ace HUD part, scroll to resize, right-click to reset
The loot reveal strip can now be moved and resized too
Fusion Machine helper: a panel beside the Fusion Machine shows your plan's next fusion and what you still need
The shards that go into that fusion get a gold outline. Turn it off under Extras
/jerry update now checks the site again every time you type it
The automatic update check runs once, when you open the Multiplayer server list
New /jerry shards menu: real shard icons, an icon bar for each type, and how many you need for max
Hover a shard's icon for its lore. Click it for how to get it, or its fusion tree
Swap any step in a fusion tree (break down, hunt instead, or another recipe), and pick a goal level or Max
Push a shard path to the site's Fusion planner and back. /ace works the same as /jerry

/jerry shards: your shards from Hypixel's API (or your Hunting Box), search any shard and its quickest recipe
Add a shard recipe to /jerry plan to track it on your HUD
Press R on a shard in any menu to open its recipe
Search bar on the Pets menu, and items in your Forge now count on the plan HUD
Garden visitor helper: see what each visitor wants and whether your sacks and storage have it
/jerry trophy fills in every Trophy Fish tier from Hypixel's API
Case-opening reveal for Crystal Nucleus bundles and dungeon chests
Glow Jerry players and an Extras page in /jerry settings

New Extras page in /jerry settings for all of these

Parts you already have (like Gemstone Mixtures) take their ingredients off the list
Steps you can make now show on the HUD, e.g. Gemstone Mixture 12/40 left
Recipe tree in /jerry plan: see every step, what's done and what's ready
